description: BFT quorum consensus decision-core golden vectors — the shared seed for cross-language agreement (F#/C#/TS/Rust). From src/Core/Consensus.fs. quorumThreshold(n) = 2*floor((n-1)/3)+1 (the classic 2f+1 BFT quorum for n=3f+1). decide(votes) groups the vote VALUES by value preserving first-occurrence order, stable-sorts by descending count, and commits the top value iff its support reaches quorumThreshold(total-vote-count); else rejects with the best support seen. Pure integer; tie-break = first-occurrence (stable sort). The vote state machine (transition) carries timestamps and is out of byte-lock scope. result: {committed, value (null on reject), count, total}.
